name: ltx2_split_rotary
description: Split-half rotary embedding for LTX2. x is [B,T,H*D] and cos/sin are [B,H,T,D/2]. Reshape x to [B,T,H,D], split the head dimension into halves x1/x2, compute o1=(x1*cos).to(bfloat16).float()-x2.float()*sin.float() and o2=(x2*cos).to(bfloat16).float()+x1.float()*sin.float(), concatenate and reshape back. The bfloat16 rounding of the cosine products is part of the contract. Returns a new tensor shaped like x. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with head_dim 64/128, heads 8/16 and T 1..2048.
